name: Jira
description: Your Jira Cloud issues in lanes (Backlog, In progress, Mentioned, On hold, Done), unread marks, sorted by Jev triage, discussed with Claude. Read-only towards Jira. Provides the jira service (issue status, the issue view) to other plugins, such as bronos.gmail.
author: Oleg Bronzov

site.title: Site
site.description: Your Jira Cloud address, https only: https://<name>.atlassian.net

email.title: Email
email.description: The email of your Atlassian account (the one the API token belongs to).

apiToken.title: API token
apiToken.description: Create one at id.atlassian.com > Security > API tokens. A token with scopes works too (read-only: read:jira-work and read:jira-user). Tokens expire: when Jira refuses it, create a new one here.

tokenKind.title: Token kind
tokenKind.description: Auto tries the site first and, when it refuses the token, the Atlassian API gateway (where tokens with scopes work).

lanes.title: Lanes
lanes.description: Which lanes to show. A hidden lane is not fetched and never sent to triage.

rowsPerLane.title: Issues per lane
rowsPerLane.description: How many issues a lane shows; the rest are behind Show all at the bottom of the lane.

onHoldStatuses.title: On hold statuses
onHoldStatuses.description: Status names that count as On hold (Waiting, Blocked, Code Review, ...), any letter case.

doneDays.title: Done: days back
doneDays.description: How far back the Done lane looks.

mentionDays.title: Mentioned: days back
mentionDays.description: How far back the Mentioned lane looks for mentions of you.

mentionProjects.title: Mentioned: projects
mentionProjects.description: Project keys searched for mentions of you (ABC, OPS). Empty: the projects of your assigned issues.

pollMinutes.title: Poll every (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: Only while this project's window is open.

mailSenders.title: Notification senders
mailSenders.description: The addresses Jira's notification mails come from, for other plugins (Gmail) to recognise them. Empty: jira@<your site's host>, Jira Cloud's own sender.

triageText.title: What triage reads
triageText.description: Full: the description and comments go to Jev (through Jev triage). Summary: only key, summary, status, priority and type, for employers who object to issue text leaving.

cli.name: jira
cli.summary: Jira: status, refresh, list the lanes, show an issue, mark read or unread
cli.usage: jira status | refresh | list [lane] | show <KEY> | read <KEY> | unread <KEY> | help
